conditions: The item must be a doc (a Linear document, not an issue, project, or attachment) that lives within the "Checkout Redesign" project in Linear.

Among docs in that project, the target must be the one most recently edited by Leo Park specifically — i.e., Leo Park's edit (any edit, not necessarily creation) must be the latest edit timestamp on that doc compared to Leo Park's edit timestamps on other docs in the same project.
"Leo Park" must resolve to exactly one identifiable person/user in the workspace (not a similarly named person).

There must be exactly one such doc (Leo Park's single most-recently-edited doc in that project) for the request to be unambiguous; if Leo Park edited multiple docs in the project and it's unclear which one is meant, or if no doc in the project was ever edited by Leo Park, the reference fails.
The action is to rename this doc's title to exactly "Checkout QA plan" (not append, not change content).

readings: The doc that, among all docs Leo Park has edited anywhere, was most recently edited by him, and which happens to be in the Checkout Redesign project (i.e., project is just a locating detail, and 'last' means most recent overall edit by Leo Park)

The doc within the Checkout Redesign project that Leo Park most recently edited, i.e., comparing only Leo Park's edits to docs scoped to that project (project restricts the candidate set before finding his last edit)
The most recent edit event attributed to Leo Park on that doc (could be a minor edit, not necessarily substantial content change)

The doc where Leo Park was the last person to edit it (i.e., the most recent edit overall on the doc, and that edit happened to be made by Leo Park) — a distinct but related reading focusing on 'last editor' of the doc rather than 'last doc Leo Park touched'
Modifies 'the doc' — the doc must belong to/be filed under the Checkout Redesign project
Modifies 'last edited' — restricting the search to edits made while working in that project's context (unlikely but conceivable if Leo Park could edit docs from elsewhere)
